name: Voyager 2 (baseline): Jupiter → Saturn → Uranus → Neptune
description: Historical launch and flyby sequence; illustrative patched-conic baseline calibrated to the final heliocentric escape speed, not a reconstructed ephemeris. Dates in event ids/notes are historical annotations, not engine scheduling. See docs/analyses/voyager-baselines.md.

events.notes: Historical Jupiter flyby: 1979-07-09. Nominal model periapsis; B-plane orientation is illustrative. No powered burn.
Historical Saturn flyby: 1981-08-25. Nominal model periapsis; B-plane orientation is illustrative. No powered burn.
Historical Uranus flyby: 1986-01-24. Nominal model periapsis; B-plane orientation is illustrative. No powered burn.
Historical Neptune flyby: 1989-08-25. Nominal model periapsis; B-plane orientation is illustrative. No powered burn.
